7.9.22.1 Requirements
[SWS_Os_00625]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_80006
⌈The AUTOSAR Operating System API function GetCoreID shall be callable before
StartOS.⌋
[SWS_Os_00627]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_80001
⌈An implementation shall define a set of constants OS_CORE_ID_<No> of the type
CoreIdType with <No> a value from 0 to OsNumberOfCores-1.⌋
[SWS_Os_00628]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_80001
⌈An implementation shall offer a constant OS_CORE_ID_MASTER of the type CoreI-
dType that refers to the master core.⌋
